author: Tekcrezec162
body:
I find that most of the items are too costly and that we have to pay a ridiculous amount of points to get underpowered items
10+ points for a fire aspect torch does not get you very far.
30 points for a Spanky Spade seems a bit too pricey(change to 20-25?)
And of course the snowballs 
I find them pointless because they deal no damage and very little knockback,and they happen to cost 10 
or more points.
Please leave constructive feedback about how you agree/disagree with my opinion.
Thanks for reading :)

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Things to add: 

  • Full Iron Armor set + Sword: 15 points
  • 64 logs: 10 points
  • Power II Bow: 20 points
  • Sharpness III Wooden Sword: 30 points (Has about +8 attack damage)
  • 5 spider eggs: 10 points
  • 5 zombie eggs: 15 points
  • 5 skeleton eggs: 20 points
  • 5 creeper eggs: 25 points

Things to change:

  • Spanky spade to KB II
  • Snowballs causing explosions. I suggest it explodes or at least make it cause a withering effect. Change to 30 points to get 5 of these if they explode or 15 points for 5 if they do a wither effect. 
  • Get rid of the 16 arrows, we already got the 64 arrow thing or at least change it to 32 arrows.
  • What's the point of the music discs. Why are they so damn overpriced if they don't interfere with combat. Change the discs to 10 points and the jukebox to 10 points as well. And please add Mellohi. 
  • The Flaming Torch should have sharpness V on it and then put at 20 points.
  • And for goodness sakes, make the Nebula points stay with us even if we log off! I'm sure everyone will love dis.

-Zintenka
